summary: Microsoft's newest base images, and the earlier sign-in component removed.

fixes.title: Security updates for the base images
fixes.text: The engine, the updater, the web app and the MCP server are rebuilt on Microsoft's newest .NET base images, with Microsoft's latest security fixes.

fixes.title: Earlier sign-in component removed
fixes.text: Every installation signs in with Microsoft's built-in sign-in. The separate sign-in component that came before it is no longer carried, built or offered.
